parts: TO MY FRIENDS

Few people can say they have a friend like mine. And I am proud of that, but I also know that you are the only person I can truly tell. Because true friendship is not put on display; it is glimpsed by chance. It is not spoken of; it is heard without listening. And no one can judge it, because no one else knows it as we do.

To some, these may be nothing more than words, but to others, especially those who share that friendship, they mean something more. It is something only those who feel it can understand, something freely given and shown without asking for or expecting anything in return...
I have been lucky enough to meet some truly wonderful, kind-hearted people who
have shown me that, despite time, distance and circumstances, they have been, are and will ALWAYS be there.
That is why we want to say something to you:
THANK YOU FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS!

First of all, I would like to thank Mari Luz and Keli (A Veiga do Frio) for their friendship, support and affection, and for always welcoming us into their home. They have been there whenever we have needed them, selflessly, without asking for anything in return. They have shared their experiences, their stories, their joys and sorrows, their knowledge and their love of Old English Sheepdogs with us... All this despite the distance between us.

To Mari Luz and Jesus (Gonssor), who started out in this world at almost the same time as we did and, through the years, have remained steadfastly by our side, supporting us and helping us with everything we need. We have so much fun together at dog shows. They have also helped us get to know their favourite breeds, the Siberian Husky and the Chihuahua.

To Patricia and Dante (Sparkling Bear's), for placing their trust in us, for bringing the joy of Shakira and Thalia into our lives, and for making our little Nano the foundation of their breeding programme. These two people have changed our lives forever and, despite the distance, have shown us what wonderful people they are... I also thank them for sharing their knowledge of grooming, caring for and breeding our beloved breed.

To Maike and Marta (the owners of our little Moon, Zoe and Ruby), for all their support, our conversations and their good advice; for sharing those moments with us, opening their hearts and making a little room for us in their lives; for all the times we have spent together and the many more still to come.

To Janet and David (Breedonhill), for their kindness, for welcoming me into their home, inviting me to visit and taking me to Crufts. It was a truly special experience that I will never forget, and I will be forever grateful to them. I also thank them for sharing their knowledge with me. They know how much I admire them.
To all our friends: Rebeca and Moisés, Asun and José Ramón, Aida and César, Miguel Ángel and Rosa, Marta and Jaime, Laura y Santi; for always being there. They know what they mean to us...
Our thanks also go to Ana Belén Velasco and José Tapia (Briguis) for sharing their experiences with us and introducing us to the Briard breed.

We thank Christina Bailey (Zottel's) for placing her trust in us and sending us our beloved London, who has grown into a magnificent dog, the dog of our dreams, and brings us so much joy. We also want to thank her for teaching me how to groom an Old English Sheepdog and for introducing us to Douglas Johnson (Bugaboo's), who has taught us how to give our shaggy companions a truly spectacular finish. I will be forever grateful to them for making one of my dreams come true!
We also want to thank Davor and Andrea Javor (Reata's) for bringing our beloved Neo into our lives, an Old English Sheepdog we will never forget.
Our thanks to Marilina Ruiz (Catmichel) for those magnificent Persian cats we are so very proud of.
To everyone who has taught us about dogs and shared their experiences and knowledge with us. And to everyone who has offered us their friendship...

And above all, to everyone who has placed their trust in us and in the quality and temperament of our Old English Sheepdogs and Shih Tzu, taking home not only a Big-Foot dog, but also a little piece of us and of our hearts.
TO EVERY ONE OF YOU: THANK YOU!
Our thanks also go to all the national and international judges who have recognised our dogs' qualities and awarded them the highest rating.
TO MY FRIENDS
There is something in this life that is hard to find:
True friends, the kind whose hearts are true.
Those you love and learn to understand;
With whom you share your sorrows and your joys.
A friend stands by you and tells you what is true,
And when you make mistakes, knows how to forgive you.
<<Friend>>, a lovely word, yet a word too seldom real,
A word that in this life is hard to use sincerely.
I have found a friend, and I will not let him go.
For a friend is hard to find, and friendship cannot be bought.
For greater than my pride, there is one enduring truth,
The truth of having a friend who truly hears me.
With him I share secrets no one else could ever guess.
He is all I have, yet I ask for nothing more.
For a friend is worth more than a sorrowful reality;
A world without life, without a light to guide you.
So if you find a friend, never let them go,
For once that friend is lost, you cannot bring them back.
For all my friends, whom I love and cherish.
